requirements.text: 正式仓库只有 project/；四个主Tab“今天 / 菜谱 / 日历 / 我的”；不加第五个助手Tab、挡内容悬浮球或无功能星星。
非菜品区域用温暖餐桌A；菜品卡片、助手整页/气泡/推荐用轻透F。旧“禁止强玻璃”不否定后来采用的轻透F。
品牌#28634E、背景#F8F7F2、正文#25332B、当前辅助#56645B；F底#E9F0E9，145度#E4EEDA→#F5ECE2(60%)→#D7E9E3，白色66%面/74%边。不得逐卡堆模糊。
现有字体24/18/16/13/12，正文与菜名16、行高1.5、长文1.65；正常44×44触控、主按钮至少48高；fontScale 1/1.3/2。大字允许增高换行，不压缩文字换首屏数量。
间距4/8/12/16/20/24/32；照片缩略图圆角14、详情18，常规64/F紧凑56图；菜名两行，详情完整可读；系统中文字体与现有同套图标。
图优先：保留真实封面与步骤图，无图或本次加载失败才分类占位；更换菜/地址后重置失败状态。访问成功不等于有使用权，不制造假菜品实拍。
模板与token是样式唯一源，重新生成WXSS/JS；组件样式隔离保留。按钮主实色、次描边/浅底、危险操作明确，不只用颜色表达状态。
动效100/180/200ms分别用于按压/列表/弹层；减少动态效果时关闭位移动画，不增加循环装饰或整页闪动。
今天日期、标题、横排早午晚；人数/搭配并排；已有菜单默认折叠设置；自己选菜可达。恢复、冲突、未应用设置不藏进折叠区。
荤素数量弹层不重复总菜数和介绍，只保留简短“应用后保留此搭配”；约束冲突才在受影响处说明。人数1–50、默认2，手动菜数不被人数改写。
一页同一任务一个主要动作；状态决定生成/保存/核对/查看目标；重复点当前餐次不清空菜单，跨日目标不偷偷回今天。
菜谱搜索+分类横滑+按需筛选/帮助；零选择不留空底栏，有选择才显示“本餐已选”；必要恢复任务是例外。
菜品详情菜名与分享/收藏顶部对齐；有图展示圆润主图；主操作按来源选加入/查看本餐/开始做菜，问菜是次级入口。
本餐“保留/取消保留”“想换”“省时”不写长期偏好；保留不被下一次生成自动解除；整餐时长与每道菜上限是两个字段。
复制菜谱只在编辑保存成功时创建；取消未保存不留副本；未知结果恢复原请求，来源下架仍能从恢复入口核对。
计划、购物、烹饪阅读进度、实吃分别建模；保存、买完、翻到最后一步都不能自动写“吃过”。删除计划后仍可按实际记录。
采购食材身份、形态、部位、原用量及餐次来源不能删；多来源先选餐，不能由“全部已买”猜一餐完成。
缺价为空，不补零；用户实付0合法；官方参考/真实报价日/估算/实付分开；实付只在当前采购汇总填一次，不自动分摊或做历史账本。叮咚/盒马未配置验收不开放。
助手保留独立对话页及当前餐/日历/单菜入口；单菜handoff按API+账号隔离、10分钟有效、一次消费；预填不自动发，不自动加菜；已有文字先确认替换。
空助手最多4个与能力及当前菜单相关的快捷项；上下文一行、菜单折叠；新版语音隐藏，旧兼容仍提示“抱歉，该功能暂不可用”。
Python只提建议，Java鉴权、验证与执行。8类读取和3类动作是现有起点；工具存在、前端可见、服务启用、实际通过是四种不同状态。
写入必经目标/来源/变更预览、用户确认、版本/幂等/回执；未知核对原请求；过期重新核对；关助手后不能用旧预览继续写。
硬忌口、早餐资格、权限、菜品/菜单版本与保留项不能为模型降级放宽；近期避重依据明确实吃，计划不冒充实吃；标签兼容原有OR语义。
长期偏好只由明确保存更新；临时客人、一次换菜、已有食材不自动形成长期记忆。收藏不是“每次都推荐”。
质量事实按来源/hash/版本保存；未知份数、克数、时间、营养保持未知。质量异常不得使普通浏览全停，也不得继承失效的换算资格。
图片目前有精确旧域名兼容；本方案保留现有范围，不推广为全局TLS关闭或任意取图代理。凭据/私人数据不进公开菜库或日志。
网页个人数据属于本浏览器IndexedDB；共享公开菜库不等于与微信同步；不绘制未实现网页助手或假云端保存。备份/恢复/回收站语义保留。
草稿、会话及事件保留期分别以当前代码/配置核对，不因UI修改扩大；已有回执、清理、恢复边界不可破坏。
当前V4优先，旧聊天仅兼容；旧同步单并发不扩到V4。已有墓碑/普通分页/复杂排除缓存/旧聊天忙提示修复只回归，不重做。
API/账号/请求代次隔离；切账号、切环境、退后台后迟到响应不能污染新页面，弱网不伪装退出登录。
删除冗余技术和过程文字，保留用户决定所需的失败、限制、权限、未知和恢复；错误给可执行下一步，不透传SQL/堆栈/供应商原文。
预览与实际页面同源验收；截图采集、几何、交互、真机、真实数据、真实模型分开记录；不能以截图数量充当通过率。

tasks.title: 冻结保留契约与可验证基线（保留回归）
tasks.evidenceNote: 175 planned cases / 27 routes / 32 contracts; baseline Node 14/14; fresh native before capture blocked and explicitly not claimed

tasks.title: 安全错误与最小观测（完善）
tasks.evidenceNote: Java 14/14 and Node 3/3; original errors RED 3 failures then GREEN; metrics compile-red then bounded-label behavior passes; logs t02-*

tasks.title: 全量质量审计、分项资格与坏记录隔离（完善）
tasks.evidenceNote: Python13/13; Java24/24; whole 6665-row source audit reproducible; 100 UNKNOWN source-linked candidates; raw source unchanged

tasks.title: 图片与菜谱事实贯通两端（完善）
tasks.evidenceNote: Node77/77; web5/5; Python2/2; typecheck passed; full 6665 URL syntax + 10/10 bounded HTTPS image probes; version lifecycle RED-GREEN

tasks.title: 推荐质量、显式偏好与真实理由（完善）
tasks.evidenceNote: Node17/17; web59/59; targeted Java22 and broader recommendation/workspace81 pass; grounded max2 reasons; no permanent learned preference

tasks.title: 助手上下文去重与扩展协商（完善）
tasks.evidenceNote: Java93/93; Node41/41; Python context3 + step32 pass; duplicate history RED-GREEN; old requests omit optional UI features; paired extension probe does not call supplier

tasks.title: 合法选项、个人内容读取与结构化澄清（新增连接）
tasks.evidenceNote: Java103/103; Python89 with 88 pass and1 skip; personal read tools and ten-minute owner/version-scoped choices; choice reservation atomic with turn claim; MySQL rollback deferred T21. Ruling: split personal reads and guidance responsibilities; server normalized questions determine options, optional model declaration grants no authority.

tasks.title: 新助手历史与原会话恢复（新增连接）
tasks.evidenceNote: Node47/47; Java105/105; same-time owner scoped keyset history; original session and pending request preservation; templates generated; V8_20 additive indexes manifest verified; no database migration or native claim.

tasks.title: 助手到已有功能的安全交接（新增连接）
tasks.evidenceNote: Node242/242; Java108 before final48 targeted regressions; Python91 run89pass1skip1 Windows file replacement error, affected14-suite rerun all passed. Seven safe page handoffs; maturity.2 rejects older incomplete extension pair; repeated clarification retains root intent and prior choices; templates/77JSON valid. Ruling: reuse actual/favorite detail/menu confirmation paths and keep full preference editor rather than invent an inferred patch.

tasks.title: 全旅程状态与中断继续（完善）
tasks.evidenceNote: Node75/75; unified pure priority table and scoped recovery pointers; exact saved target; multi-source shopping never implies eaten; ten duplicate confirmations one fixture boundary write; no second request queue. Regression caught empty needs_regeneration action drift, restored old regeneration semantics. Real DB assertions remain T21.

tasks.title: 共享组件、大字、键盘、读屏和动效（完善）
tasks.evidenceNote: Node74/74; Python structure2/2; generated styles and strict motion ms bindings; reusable keyboard sheet confirmation; accessible field names and large-font input height; stale measurement guards. T09 optional handoff module loads only for token path. Native registration regression caught and fixed T08 history icon path. Native widths/keyboard/reader pending T23: WeChat process not running.

tasks.title: 今天与本餐结果精修（完善）
tasks.evidenceNote: Node51/51; Python structure2/2; generated workspace style; one actionable notice, row-local replacement and menu undo, concise composition note, real exclusions preserved on expansion and failed-read warning. All existing command functions retained. 390 first-screen count and large-font native geometry explicitly pending T23.

tasks.title: 菜谱、详情、收藏、个人菜与常用菜单（完善）
tasks.evidenceNote: Node165/165; Python structure2/2; generated style; browse query scope and pagination recovery, return scroll without feedback loop, title-photo-ingredients-steps order, contextual favorites footer. Ruling: evidence-based main time label supersedes unreviewed numeric label, raw legacy duration retained in supplement; explicit unknown/estimated/verified tests. Native interaction pending T23.

tasks.title: 日历、实际用餐与回顾（完善）
tasks.evidenceNote: 49 Node checks pass; full-date accessible labels and inert blanks, one primary action plus more, explicit skipped semantics and multiline actual editor; no database or native proof. Ruling: calendar-wide assistant routes to meal selection first to avoid inventing a meal target; cost one extra selection. Shared actual styles moved globally because calendar/cooking use the same template.

tasks.title: 采购、费用与来源完整衔接（完善）
tasks.evidenceNote: 122 Node checks pass; costs restored only on explicit expand, capability/backoff and scoped version guard, missing/zero/unconvertible rules, current-summary expense editor and calendar entry. Ruling: prior test forbidding every cost entry superseded by approved T15 optional-cost requirement; auto-read prohibition retained; cost if wrong is a folded entry. DB and native not yet verified.

tasks.title: 做菜阅读与继续（完善现有进度，不重造）
tasks.evidenceNote: 50 Node checks pass; exact readable content signatures, active dish and per-ID reading resume, material foldout, structured steps, storage failure read-through and future actual guard. Ruling: pre-signature progress cannot prove source equality and resets once; cost loss of old reading position only, no business records. Native acceptance pending.

tasks.title: 助手对话、结果卡与历史界面（完善）
tasks.evidenceNote: 80 Node assistant/history checks and 2 UI structure checks pass. Clarification choices/date picker connected with exact unknown-child UUID recovery; one active task card; foreground capability recheck; preserved input and non-forced historical scroll. No model or native proof. Includes generated workspace CSS removal of the shared actual styles moved globally in T14, inadvertently left unstaged then.
